title: igmpv2 security considerations and key changes from igmpv1
summary: section 10 (security considerations) of rfc 2236 details how to prevent forged messages that could disrupt igmp group membership management. section 13 (appendix i - changes from igmpv1) outlines specific improvements in igmpv2, including standardizing the querier election mechanism and requiring router alert options for enhanced security.

security measures.threat: forged query message causing querier role assignment or unnecessary traffic
security measures.impact: assigns querier duties to forger; causes temporary loss of membership updates

security measures.threat: externally forged v1 reports causing 'members present' state when there are none
security measures.impact: triggers group-specific queries, extra processing, potential traffic loss up to [group membership interval]

security measures.threat: forged reports making multicast routers think members exist on a subnet
security measures.impact: may cause unnecessary group membership reports from hosts

security measures.threat: externally forged leave messages triggering new queries
security measures.impact: extra processing, but no loss of desired traffic; can break querier state if not handled correctly

security defenses.description: ignore messages from sources that do not belong to the local subnet assigned to the receiving interface.
require ip router alert option [rfc 2113] and do not forward report or leave messages via routers.
security defenses.note: breaking backwards compatibility with implementations that do not support router alert

security defenses.description: configurable switch to ignore version 1 messages completely for scenarios where fast leave is critical.

igmpv2 improvements over v1.description: eliminates the need for different mechanisms per multicast routing protocol, though care must be taken when coexisting with igmpv1 routers
combines version and type fields into a single 'type' field for easier identification of v1 vs v2 reports
all igmpv2 packets must include the ip router alert option [rfc 2113]
uses a previously unused field in queries to carry max response time
new message type introduced for igmpv2 leave group handling
